item1_f1.justification: Two of the three sites already collapsed; 'fixture' is harness/verification material, not a claim's mining provenance; 'unknown' is fail-closed and store.producer_is_model('fixture') is False, so the collapse cannot grant standing. The claim level renders only the standing-bearing classes (model/replay).

item2_f2.semantics_chosen: Option (a): claim.producer keeps meaning the ASSESSING (verdict) producer, because a claim's standing is asserted by the assessment and store.may_back_model_claim_verdict blesses a model verdict on replay-mined material; reversing would re-attribute a model's assessment to the miner. But producer is not mining provenance, so when the assessing producer differs from the claim-level mining producer, _claim_for records the mining provenance in the claim's verdict_reason. Claim-level provenance is therefore a two-part statement: producer = assessment authority, verdict_reason = divergence note naming the miner. No divergence => no note => byte-identical output for replay dockets with no verdicts.
item2_f2.mining_provenance_now_visible_where: claim.verdict_reason (rendered into docket manifest.json beside producer); docket-level generated_by.producer remains the mining provenance
